blocks.label: Engineering
blocks.body: Engineering is how I turn ideas into something real. I enjoy solving problems through CAD, machining, and rapid prototyping, then seeing those designs come together into a finished product. I study Mechanical Engineering at The University of Texas at Austin and am interested in designing machines that are simple, reliable, and built with purpose.

blocks.label: Robotics
blocks.body: I design and build competition robots with FRC Team 6800 Valor, where I have led mechanical subsystems, fabricated parts, and driven at competitions. I also organize engineering opportunities for students through the Valor CAD Challenge.

blocks.label: Outside the shop
blocks.body: Outside of robotics, I spend time designing and printing projects, cooking, and bouldering. I enjoy learning new manufacturing methods and finding better ways to build things.

bullets: Led the Downpour shooter subsystem for the 2026 FIRST Robotics Competition robot, which won the Curie Division at the World Championship and earned Excellence in Engineering and Industrial Design Awards.
Designed the full-width drum shooter, variable hood, and feeder; planned manufacturing in Jira, verified components, assembled the subsystem, and supported integration with electrical and software.
Designed and fabricated Deadlock's climber latch and pivot system, using motor curves, lever-arm calculations, and center-of-gravity analysis to size and balance the mechanism.
Prototyped the mechanism in 3D print, then manufactured and assembled the final subsystem; the robot won the Texas District Championship and earned three Industrial Design Awards.
Designed Flatline's two-sided pivoting shooter in Onshape and oversaw fabrication and assembly, integrating the shooter with the robot's intake and climber.
Co-organized an online FTC design challenge, creating the field and game elements, writing rules, coordinating sponsors and judges, and helping run the final livestream.
The challenge brought together 117 participants, received 28 submissions, and reached more than 750 viewers at the awards livestream.
